 TOI Entertainment Desk / etimes.in / Oct 30, 2026, 15:21 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Ibrahim Ali Khan , son of Saif Ali Khan and Amrita Singh, has long been linked with Shweta Tiwari ’s daughter, Palak Tiwari . The two never publicly confirmed a relationship, but their regular outings and appearances together kept the speculation alive. Now, a recent report suggests that Ibrahim and Palak have called it quits after more than three years of dating. Ibrahim Ali Khan reportedly initiated the breakup
 According to a Hindustan Times, Ibrahim was the one who ended things. Earlier this month, the former couple were seen together on a tiger safari in Ranthambore, and they still follow each other on social media. With an episode of a celebrity talk show featuring Ibrahim set to air soon, he reportedly doesn’t want news of the breakup to overshadow his appearance. Ibrahim Ali Khan on Koffee With Karan Season 9 ?
 The buzz has also led to talk that Ibrahim may be a guest on Karan Johar’s Koffee With Karan Season 9, but nothing has been officially confirmed so far. According to the report, any shoots lined up with Ibrahim and Palak have either been scrapped or postponed. Ibrahim Ali Khan and Palak Tiwari yet to confirm split
 However, neither Ibrahim nor Palak has publicly confirmed the relationship or the alleged split. When Ibrahim Ali Khan and Palak Tiwari first sparked dating rumours
 Dating rumours around Palak, television actor Shweta Tiwari’s daughter, and Ibrahim began in 2022. The pair made headlines when they were spotted outside a Mumbai restaurant, with Palak trying to cover her face from the paparazzi.
